name: get_supplier_performance
description: Get a supplier performance scorecard: on-time delivery, quality acceptance, lead time and variability, cost competitiveness, defect rate (PPM), spend, contract status, and risk assessment.

name: list_suppliers
description: List suppliers ranked by overall score for a product category (or all), with on-time %, quality %, lead time, status, and YTD spend.

category.description: Product category or 'all' for all suppliers (Default: all)

name: create_purchase_order
description: Create a purchase order for a supplier with line items. Returns PO confirmation with totals (tax, shipping), payment terms, and estimated delivery.

items.description: JSON array of items to order, e.g. '[{"sku": "SKU-001", "quantity": 100, "unit_price": 25.99}]'

name: get_supplier_risk_report
description: Get a supply chain risk assessment: single-source dependencies, geographic concentration, financial health watch list, lead-time risk, top risks with mitigations, and recommendations.
